name: spec-system
description: Spec-as-truth development and the whole engineering loop around it. Specs in specs/ are the source of truth, pinned to the code by content hash. spec-shape interviews before building; spec-amend derives a plan from the spec delta; spec-run executes plans unattended with an implementer and a reviewer subagent per task, parks behaviour questions instead of guessing, and moves the pin last. Disciplines: tdd, debug, review, architecture, fan-out, merge-conflicts, finish.
